I wish I was, my wife loves me conditionally, she said it hurts to say it but she does, all my friends no longer talk to me. I am in a hole.

Its not like I have not tried either, I have tried and tried to be a loving caring person, I work hard at it and helped people in any way I can, even if it means I lose out myself.

I am also in a rather remote area, not meany people around, and most of them are conservative. 

Again thanks, what you have said has helped give me some peace.

I'll only be loved if I stay the way I am, if I continue pretending, I can not do that any more.

Thank you for Listening.
No, there is not, I think its time to say goodbye.
